---
title: "Poverty vs Income Scatterplot"
author: "Alejandra Chavarria"
date: "2025-11-22"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

### This map compares **median household income** and **poverty rate** across U.S. states.  
Each state is classified into one of four categories:

- High income & low poverty  
- High income & high poverty  
- Low income & low poverty  
- Low income & high poverty (*double-disadvantaged*)

Use the dropdown to highlight a state and see its values.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(tidycensus)
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
```

---

```{r data-load, include=FALSE}
poverty_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    med_inc   = "S1901_C01_012",   
    pov_rate  = "S1701_C03_001",  
    population = "B01003_001"      
  ),
  year   = 2023,
  survey = "acs5"
) %>%
  select(NAME, variable, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = variable,
    values_from = estimate
  ) %>%
  rename(
    state         = NAME,
    median_income = med_inc,
    poverty_rate  = pov_rate,
    pop           = population
  ) %>%
  filter(state != "Puerto Rico") %>%
  mutate(
    region = state.region[match(state, state.name)],
    region = ifelse(is.na(region), "Other", region),
    region = factor(
      region,
      levels = c("1","2","3","4","Other"), 
      labels = c("Northeast","South","North Central","West","Other")
    )
  )

state_list <- sort(poverty_income$state)
```

---

```{r ui, echo=FALSE}
selectInput(
  inputId = "sel_state",
  label   = "Highlight a state:",
  choices = state_list,
  selected = "Washington"
)

plotOutput("scatter_income_poverty", height = "450px")
```

---

```{r server, echo=FALSE}
output$scatter_income_poverty <- renderPlot({

  df <- poverty_income

  ggplot(df, aes(x = median_income, y = poverty_rate)) +

    geom_point(aes(color = region), alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +

    geom_point(
      data = df[df$state == input$sel_state, ],
      aes(x = median_income, y = poverty_rate),
      color  = "black",
      fill   = "yellow",
      shape  = 21,
      size   = 5,
      stroke = 1
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = df[df$state == input$sel_state, ],
      aes(label = state),
      vjust = -1,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = comma,
      breaks = seq(40000, 110000, by = 10000)
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 45, by = 5)      
    ) +

    scale_color_brewer(
      palette = "Dark2",
      na.value = "gray50"
    ) +

    labs(
      title    = "Poverty Rate vs Median Household Income (ACS 2023)",
      subtitle = "Each point is a U.S. state; color = region",
      x        = "Median Household Income ($)",
      y        = "Poverty Rate (%)",
      color    = "Region"
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray85"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
})
```
